look_here_first: Start with ray color. Maroon blanketflower is an annual with leafy branching stems and heads carrying dark maroon-red to purple rays, usually without the bright yellow tips common in G. pulchella.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: dark red to maroon or purple rays

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: disk florets yellow to dark red with purple tips

lookalikes.differences: G. pulchella usually has conspicuous yellow-tipped red rays; G. amblyodon is much more uniformly maroon/red. G. suavis is perennial and scapose with rays often reduced or absent.
